answer.rationale: A second source best controls delivery risk while creating a path toward the mandated cost reduction. The archived shortage experience is the most relevant evidence to verify, while the low-cost vendor's prior quick onboarding and accurate invoicing support a guarded trial. Because the line is already at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, avoid an immediate full switch; retain incumbent coverage while testing qualified volume with the low-cost vendor and confirm whether the savings persist after transition and contingency costs.
